generic_name: Methenamine / Sodium Phosphate / Methylene Blue / Hyoscyamine
purpose: This medication is used to treat urinary tract infections (UTIs) and to relieve the uncomfortable symptoms that come with them, like burning, urgency, and frequent urination. It works best when the urine is kept acidic, which helps fight the bacteria causing the infection. It also helps calm bladder spasms so you feel more comfortable.
how_it_works: Methenamine turns into a germ-killing substance in acidic urine, which helps get rid of the bacteria in your bladder. Sodium phosphate helps keep your urine acidic so the methenamine can work properly. Hyoscyamine relaxes the muscles of your bladder to reduce spasms, urgency, and discomfort, while methylene blue has a mild antiseptic effect in the urinary tract.
common_side_effects: Your urine and sometimes your stool may turn blue or blue-green — this is completely normal and harmless. You may also experience dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, flushing, or difficulty urinating. Some people feel a little dizzy or have an upset stomach.
warnings: Do not take this medication if you have glaucoma, kidney disease, severe dehydration, or trouble emptying your bladder. Avoid antacids while taking this medicine since they can make your urine less acidic and stop the medication from working. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other medications, especially MAO inhibitors. Drink plenty of water unless your doctor tells you otherwise.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is one tablet or capsule taken four times a day, typically with a full glass of water. It is often taken with food to reduce stomach upset. Always follow your doctor or pharmacist's specific instructions, and try to take it at evenly spaced times throughout the day.
